C0048.title: Inside the Internet Water Army Industry: Selling Followers and Tiered Comment Packages
C0048.summary: An investigation reveals that the internet water army industry not only sells fake followers but also provides likes and view counts to maintain an illusion of popularity. After public accounts display view counts, they must also inflate these metrics to match the purchased followers and likes, forming a complete chain of fake engagement designed to deceive advertisers into placing ads.

references.title: Revealing the inner workings of the online water army industry chain: selling followers, comments also come in tiers
